title: PipeWeave: Synergizing Analytical and Learning Models for Unified GPU Performance Prediction
authors: Kaixuan Zhang; Yunfan Cui; Shuhao Zhang; Chutong Ding; Shiyou Qian; Luping Wang; Jian Cao; Guangtao Xue; Cheng Huang; Guodong Yang; Liping Zhang
venue_full: International Symposium on Computer Architecture (accepted, ISCA 2026)
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Alibaba Group
research_focus: LLM serving, MoE serving, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Existing GPU performance models cannot be simultaneously fast, accurate, and generalizable: cycle-accurate simulators are too slow, analytical models are labor-intensive with limited accuracy, and data-driven methods generalize poorly across hardware and inadequately model complex production fused kernels (e.g., FlashAttention, Fused MoE), hindering next-generation hardware selection and system-level exploration.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 GPU 效能模型難以同時兼顧速度、精度與泛化能力：cycle-accurate 模擬器過慢，解析式模型費工且精度有限，資料驅動方法跨硬體泛化不佳，也無法妥善建模生產環境常見的複雜 fused kernel（如 FlashAttention、Fused MoE），阻礙次世代硬體選型與系統層級探索。

key_innovation.en: A grey-box framework that weaves pipeline-level analysis into ML prediction: a Kernel Decomposer breaks each kernel into schedulable tasks, a Scheduling Simulator maps tasks onto SMs (covering both hardware round-robin and software persistent-kernel schedulers), a Feature Analyzer extends the Roofline model into multi-dimensional per-pipeline (Tensor/FMA/XU/MIO) demand and theoretical-cycle features, and a lightweight per-kernel MLP predicts execution efficiency; a P80 quantile-loss variant estimates a Potential Performance Ceiling for optimization guidance.
key_innovation.zh: 將 pipeline 層級分析織入 ML 預測的 grey-box 框架：Kernel Decomposer 將 kernel 拆解為可排程的 task，Scheduling Simulator 模擬 task 到 SM 的映射（涵蓋硬體 round-robin 與軟體 persistent-kernel 兩種排程機制），Feature Analyzer 將 Roofline 模型擴展為多維度、逐 pipeline（Tensor/FMA/XU/MIO）的 demand 與理論 cycle 特徵，最後由輕量級的 per-kernel MLP 預測執行效率；並以 P80 quantile loss 變體估計「潛在效能上限」，提供優化指引。

baselines_compared: Roofline, Linear regression, Habitat, Neusight, AMALI, LLMCompass

key_improvements.en: 6.1% average kernel-level error (11.4% on unseen GPUs) and 8.5% end-to-end inference error, reducing SOTA (Neusight) error by 6.7x and 4.4x respectively; versus detailed simulators AMALI and LLMCompass, lower GEMM error (MAPE 6.4% vs 28.3%/29.7%) with 3-7 orders of magnitude less prediction time; P80-ceiling-guided tuning of SGLang's production Fused MoE Triton kernel achieves up to 1.7x speedup.
key_improvements.zh: kernel 層級平均誤差 6.1%（未見過的 GPU 上為 11.4%），端到端推理誤差 8.5%，分別將 SOTA（Neusight）誤差降低 6.7x 與 4.4x；相較 AMALI 與 LLMCompass 等精細模擬器，GEMM 誤差更低（MAPE 6.4% vs 28.3%/29.7%）且預測時間減少 3–7 個數量級；以 P80 效能上限指引調校 SGLang 生產環境的 Fused MoE Triton kernel，最高獲得 1.7x 加速。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada, NVIDIA L20, NVIDIA H20, NVIDIA H800, NVIDIA RTX A6000, NVIDIA L40, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000
gpu_count: 11 GPU types (6 seen for training, 5 unseen for testing)
reported_accuracy: Kernel MAPE 6.1% seen / 11.4% unseen; E2E MAPE 8.5% seen / 10.7% unseen
validation_workloads: Synthetic (~1M profiled kernel samples), ArXiv-Summarization, Splitwise trace

scope_assumptions.en: E2E prediction assumes sequential kernel execution without overlap (following prior work); communication kernels (All-Reduce, Send/Recv) are modeled by a simplified data-driven regression (Random Forest) over a profiled baseline database rather than the analytical pipeline; contextualized within NVIDIA GPU architectures (Ampere through Blackwell); multi-node clusters and Expert Parallelism (EP) are left to future work; a separate MLP is trained per kernel category, requiring cross-GPU profiling data.
scope_assumptions.zh: 端到端預測假設 kernel 依序執行、無重疊（沿用先前研究的假設）；通訊 kernel（All-Reduce、Send/Recv）以 profiled 基準資料庫上的簡化資料驅動迴歸（Random Forest）建模，而非解析式 pipeline 分析；討論範疇限定於 NVIDIA GPU 架構（Ampere 至 Blackwell）；多節點叢集與 Expert Parallelism (EP) 留待未來工作；每類 kernel 需各自訓練一個 MLP，仰賴跨 GPU 的 profiling 資料。
